address: 2 Hatfield Road, St Albans, AL1 3RP, United Kingdom
bio: Eponymous Chef-Owner Phil Thompson’s restaurant is split over three contemporary dining rooms, each featuring bold artwork from the local gallery. The dishes are equally good-looking and can be enjoyed from either an à la carte, or a 7 or 9 course tasting menu. The kitchen’s skills are evident across the accomplished cooking, while the friendly and efficient service team run the place well....
